description: This file defines the class ObservableMdcAdapter, a thread-unsafe implementation of the MDCAdapter interface from SLF4J that delegates to BasicMDCAdapter while allowing observers to monitor method calls, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: ObservableMdcAdapter
classes.description: A thread-unsafe MDCAdapter implementation that delegates calls to BasicMDCAdapter and allows observers to monitor method invocations, mainly for testing.

classes.name: MdcAdapterObserver
classes.description: An interface for observers that wish to be notified of MDCAdapter method calls.

classes.name: AbstractMdcAdapterObserver
classes.description: A default abstract class implementing MdcAdapterObserver with empty method implementations, allowing subclasses to override only methods of interest.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ObservableMdcAdapter.

methods.name: registerObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer with the specified name.

methods.name: deregisterObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer with the specified name.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the MDC and notifies observers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key from the MDC and notifies observers.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the key from the MDC and notifies observers.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the MDC and notifies observers.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the set of MDC keys and notifies observers.

methods.name: getCopyOfContextMap
methods.description: Returns a copy of the MDC context map and notifies observers.

methods.name: setContextMap
methods.description: Sets the MDC context map and notifies observers.
